name: fences
title: Fences: mapped fences, walls, guard rails, hedges and gates from OpenStreetMap
storage: Small. OpenStreetMap (osm_barriers): about 1,300 mapped fence, wall, guard rail and hedge lines (about 270 km) and about 3,500 gates, bollards and cattle grids in the valley box, a few MB with indexes, versioned in place (no raw.record copies); it grows only by changed OSM versions, at each hand-downloaded extract. Each load adds one core.layer_version row for the 'fences.lines' layer.
ethics: OpenStreetMap is ODbL: credit "© OpenStreetMap contributors", and anything published from it stays ODbL. Geofabrik's robots.txt disallows scripted downloads, so the extract is downloaded by hand and nothing here makes a network request. Only what contributors have mapped is here, and most backyard fences aren't mapped: the layer is never a count of fences, and a mapped fence never says where a lot ends (decision of Oct 8, 2026). Hedges are stored for the shrubs' hedge check and not drawn as fences. Private people's properties are not the subject: these are map features of the road network's surroundings, and the tables hold OpenStreetMap's own tags as mapped (a name where a contributor gave one), with no owners or lot lines inferred.
